app_info.subtitle: Shop products & track orders
app_info.description: Access askoxy.ai e-commerce services directly. Discover trending items, manage your personal profile and delivery addresses, build your cart, apply coupons/wallet balances, and securely place and track your orders.

get_openai_challenge.description: Serve OpenAI apps challenge token for verification.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool simply returns a hardcoded verification token string and does not modify any state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool operates entirely locally on the server and does not make any external network requests.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool does not delete, cancel, or irreversibly modify any user data.

hello_world.description: Test connectivity to askoxy.ai MCP Server.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only returns a static connectivity message to confirm that the server is online and running.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool runs completely locally and does not interact with external endpoints or services.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool performs no data mutations, updates, or deletions.

get_product_suggestions.description: Get AI-powered personalized product recommendations based on a search query.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only retrieves and filters product listings from the API without writing or modifying server state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the external askoxy.ai search API over HTTPS to fetch dynamic suggestions.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a read-only query and does not perform any data deletion or modify user data.

send_login_otp.description: Sends a one-time password (OTP) via SMS or WhatsApp for user login.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool creates an OTP request record and session on the server and initiates a message transmission.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool interacts with external SMS and WhatsApp gateways to dispatch the OTP code to the user.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool only initiates a login request and does not delete or irreversibly modify any user data.

verify_login_otp.description: Verifies the login OTP and returns session credentials.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool validates credentials and creates an active authenticated session in the backend and token store.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool makes a POST request to the remote user-service API to verify the OTP credentials.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool completes user authentication without deleting or irreversibly modifying any user data.

send_register_otp.description: Sends a one-time password (OTP) via SMS or WhatsApp for new user registration.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool creates a new registration request and generates an OTP session in the system.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool dispatches the OTP to the user's mobile number via external SMS or WhatsApp messaging APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool only starts the registration flow and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

simple_login.description: Performs a simple login or registration without OTP verification.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool registers new user profiles or initiates sessions directly on the backend, mutating user database tables.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with the remote askoxy.ai user-service API to register or login the customer.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool registers or logs in a user profile without deleting or irreversibly modifying user data.

set_user_session.description: Directly creates a session using a pre-existing user ID and access token.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool writes a new session record into the local memory/token store of the MCP server.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool only affects the local session state of the server and does not make external web requests.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool only adds a session mapping and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

verify_otp_and_authenticate.description: Verifies the registration or login OTP and completes authentication.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool verifies OTP details, registers new users, and creates authenticated sessions in the backend.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool interacts with the remote askoxy.ai user-service API to authenticate the user.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool authenticates the user and creates a session without deleting or modifying any user data.

add_to_cart.description: Adds an item to the shopping cart or increments its quantity.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool modifies the customer's cart state by adding new items or increasing quantities.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the remote askoxy.ai cart-service API to modify the database state of the user's cart.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool only adds or increments items in the cart and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

decrement_cart_item.description: Reduces the quantity of a specific item in the shopping cart.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool modifies the cart state by decrementing the quantity of an item.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the remote askoxy.ai cart-service API over HTTP to reduce item counts.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool decrements item quantity and does not delete user data or cart items directly.

remove_cart_item.description: Removes an item completely from the shopping cart.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool deletes the item entry from the user's active shopping cart, modifying cart state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool sends a POST request to the remote askoxy.ai cart-service API to remove the item.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool deletes item records from the customer's shopping cart, which is an irreversible modification of cart data.

view_user_cart.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's current shopping cart items and totals.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only fetches cart items and calculated pricing summary without modifying any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool fetches active cart data from the remote askoxy.ai cart-service API.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is purely informational and performs no data modification or deletion.

fetch_cart_summary.description: Fetches the user's cart summary as a single source of truth for checkout calculations.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only retrieves cart values and items without modifying any database records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with the remote askoxy.ai cart-service API to retrieve checkout values.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a read-only query that does not delete or irreversibly modify any user data.

get_user_addresses.description: Retrieves delivery addresses available for the checkout process.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is read-only and lists stored customer addresses without altering any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with the remote user-service API to retrieve the customer's address list.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a simple data retrieval utility and does not mutate or delete user data.

validate_pincode_serviceability.description: Checks whether delivery service is active and supported for a given pincode.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool reads the list of active pincodes to check serviceability and does not write any state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the external askoxy.ai order-service API to validate delivery service availability.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool performs a lookup query and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

calculate_delivery_charges.description: Calculates delivery and handling charges based on location coordinates and cart value.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only runs calculation logic on the input parameters and does not write any state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calculates shipping fees locally based on business logic without requesting external APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a computational utility and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

get_available_coupons.description: Retrieves the list of coupons applicable to the customer's current checkout.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is read-only and queries active promotional codes without altering database states.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with the remote askoxy.ai order-service API to fetch coupon offers.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool only fetches coupon information and does not modify or delete user data.

apply_wallet_amount.description: Applies wallet or coin balance to the checkout total.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool modifies the user's active checkout session state by applying a wallet amount.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool sends a POST request to the remote askoxy.ai order-service API to apply the balance.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool applies a discount allocation and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

fetch_delivery_slots.description: Retrieves available delivery dates and time range slots.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only lists available delivery time windows and does not mutate any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the remote askoxy.ai order-service API to query available dispatch slots.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool reads schedule availability and does not modify or delete user data.

initiate_payment.description: Initiates the payment transaction process for the checkout order.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool creates a new payment transaction entry in the backend system, changing checkout state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool makes a POST request to the external askoxy.ai order-service API to register a transaction.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool initiates a transaction request and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

confirm_payment.description: Confirms payment transaction success and creates the corresponding order.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool completes the transaction, creates order records, and clears the user's shopping cart.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool sends payment confirmation events to the remote order-service API to finalize the checkout.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool completes payment, which irreversibly clears the user's cart, deducts wallet balance, and creates an order.

validate_checkout.description: Performs final comprehensive validations before placing the order.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only performs safety and serviceability checks on the cart and address without writing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool aggregates verification requests across several remote askoxy.ai APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a read-only validation check and does not modify or delete user data.

get_order_history.description: Retrieves the customer's previous orders and status history.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only fetches historical order records and does not change database states.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool fetches order archives from the remote askoxy.ai order-service API.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is read-only and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

get_order_details.description: Retrieves detailed item and status information for a specific order.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only queries order and address tables without writing or modifying records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool requests details from the remote askoxy.ai order-service API for a given order ID.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a details query and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

track_order.description: Retrieves tracking information and delivery status updates for an order.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only queries tracking logs and delivery updates without mutating state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with the remote order-service tracking API to fetch current logistics info.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool retrieves delivery tracking data and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

cancel_order.description: Cancels an eligible order based on the cancelation policy.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool alters database records by changing the status of an active order to cancelled.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the remote askoxy.ai order-service cancellation API over HTTPS.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool cancels an active order, which irreversibly changes the order status and initiates refunds.

get_order_summary.description: Retrieves cart items and order summary details for checkout.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool reads current customer cart details and summaries without making any changes.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool requests checkout summary information from the remote cart-service API.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool fetches shopping cart summary data and does not modify or delete user data.

reorder_item.description: Adds a previously ordered item back into the user's active shopping cart.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool modifies the customer's cart state by adding the selected item.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool sends a POST request to the remote cart-service API to update active cart entries.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool adds items to the cart and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

get_cancelled_orders.description: Retrieves the list of cancelled orders for the customer.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only retrieves historical logs of cancelled orders and does not change database records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the remote askoxy.ai order-service cancel list endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a read-only log fetcher and does not perform data deletions or modifications.

get_exchange_orders.description: Retrieves the list of exchange orders for the customer.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool reads the customer's product exchange requests list without modifying database states.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the remote order-service exchange API to list exchange records.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool performs a lookup of exchange records and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

check_order_conditions.description: Validates cart and order constraints before order checkout.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is read-only and verifies constraints on cart value and address without writing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with remote cart and user address APIs to check checkout readiness.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a check mechanism and does not perform any data deletions or modifications.

check_delivery_availability.description: Checks serviceability and delivery options for a given destination pincode.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool checks delivery zone tables for service availability and does not write records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool requests delivery availability details from the remote askoxy.ai delivery-service API.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool checks pincode eligibility and does not modify or delete user data.

place_order.description: Places an order after checking conditions and cart details.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool creates a new order in the database and updates cart status, modifying state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the remote order-service place order API to submit order payloads.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool creates a binding purchase order in the user profile and irreversibly modifies cart state.

get_combo_item_details.description: Fetches combo offer item definitions and pricing details.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool reads package/combo definitions from the database and does not modify any state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool calls the remote product-service combo API to fetch specific bundle information.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool only reads package combinations and does not modify or delete user data.

get_product_images.description: Fetches image URLs associated with a product item ID.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool performs read-only lookups on product assets and does not write state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool requests product image directories from the remote askoxy.ai product-service.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool only retrieves item image metadata and does not modify or delete user data.

get_trending_products.description: Retrieves popular trending products from the public catalog.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool reads product views and catalog records without writing or changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool fetches catalog lists from the public remote askoxy.ai product-service endpoint.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a public read-only catalog query and does not delete or modify user data.

dynamic_product_search.description: Searches the product catalog using keywords.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool performs catalog keyword searches without writing any records or state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool requests dynamic searches from the remote askoxy.ai product-service API.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool performs read-only database search queries and does not delete or modify user data.

view_address_list.description: Retrieves saved delivery addresses for the authenticated user.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool lists saved addresses without writing or changing user records.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool retrieves stored addresses from the remote askoxy.ai user-service.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool lists user address files and does not modify or delete user data.

add_address.description: Saves a new delivery address after resolving coordinates.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool adds a new address record to the customer profile database.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool invokes Google Maps API for geocoding and calls user-service API to save the address.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool adds user profile records and does not delete or irreversibly modify user data.

get_customer_profile.description: Retrieves profile details for the authenticated customer.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool reads user registration and account details without writing any state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool queries customer profile details from the remote askoxy.ai user-service.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is a read-only account query and does not delete or modify user data.

update_customer_profile.description: Updates personal profile information for the customer.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool modifies name, email, and contact fields in the customer database record.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool sends profile update requests to the remote askoxy.ai user-service API.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool overwrites existing contact details with updated info, but does not delete profile accounts.

test_cases.description: Retrieve popular trending items from the store's public catalog without authentication.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the trending products in the store.
test_cases.expected_output: A list of popular items containing names, prices, MRPs, images, and category groupings.

test_cases.description: Add a specific grocery product to the customer's active shopping cart.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add milk to my cart. The product ID is item_102 and I want 2 of them.
test_cases.expected_output: A success message confirming that the item has been added or incremented in the cart.

test_cases.description: Fetch order history for the currently logged-in customer.
test_cases.expected_output: A list of past orders with detailed info such as payment methods, totals, dates, and order status.

test_cases.description: Track the current delivery status of an active customer order.
test_cases.user_prompt: Track my latest order. The order ID is order_5001.
test_cases.expected_output: A status report indicating the current tracking step, logistics partner, and expected delivery date.

test_cases.description: Verify if the delivery service serves a specific destination postal code.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check if delivery is available for pincode 560001.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirmation that delivery is available, with estimated shipping charges and timeline.

negative_test_cases.description: Attempt to modify cart contents when not logged in.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: An authentication error indicating the session is invalid and login is required.

negative_test_cases.description: Attempt to cancel a transaction using a non-existent order ID.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: An error response stating that the order was not found or is ineligible for cancellation.

negative_test_cases.description: Attempt to check serviceability using an incorrectly formatted pincode.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Can you deliver to pincode abcde?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: A validation error indicating that the pincode format is invalid.
